title_o: Empathic-like responding by domestic dogs (Canis familiaris) to distress in humans: an exploratory study

replications.journal: Canadian Journal of Experimental Psychology / Revue canadienne de psychologie expérimentale
replications.quote: Like Custance and Mayer, dogs showed more behaviours directed toward the person crying, whether the owner or the stranger, than during baseline or laughing conditions.
